component.name: Pat Desktop
component.summary: Winlink email over radio and the internet

description.p: Pat Desktop runs Pat, the cross-platform Winlink client, as a regular desktop application: it starts from your application menu, opens in its own window and shuts Pat down cleanly when you close it. No terminal, no browser and no localhost addresses to remember.
Pat lets licensed radio amateurs send and receive Winlink email over HF and VHF/UHF radio, or over the internet. Features include:

ul.li: ARDOP, VARA HF/FM, PACTOR and AX.25 packet (AGWPE, KISS TNCs and Linux kernel AX.25)
Telnet connections to the Winlink CMS and peer-to-peer sessions
Winlink forms, position reports and GPSd support
Built-in configuration for your callsign, radio and modems

description.p: Pat Desktop is an unofficial, community-maintained wrapper. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Pat project or the Winlink Development Team. Pat itself is built unmodified from the upstream source code.

ul.li: Desktop window for Pat that starts and stops Pat automatically, with no terminal or browser needed.
Pat's own top bar doubles as the title bar: the menu and window buttons sit at its right end, and its empty space drags the window.
First launch opens Pat's configuration for callsign, radio and modems. It is also available from the menu.
Winlink forms open in their own windows. Attachments are saved with the file dialog, and external links open in the browser.
Dark mode that follows the desktop setting, in GNOME's dark colours. Winlink forms keep their own look.
Live log viewer and a Restart Pat action.
Confirmation before quitting during an active Winlink session.
